Definition: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.
BiblicalUsage: Jannes is named once, with Jambres, as one of the magicians who opposed Moses in Egypt. In 2 Timothy 3:8 Paul holds them up as the pattern for the false teachers of the last days, men who resist the truth with corrupt minds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jannes shows me that opposition to the truth is nothing new: Pharaoh's court had its own wise men, and they lost.
